items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee discusses Bennie Moten in the context of a 'Battle of Bands' and local Kansas City music history ('The boss was usually Bennie Moten'), but does not state a personal interaction, employment, or direct collaboration with Moten himself.

ctx.x: Well, these were stocks you bought, were they?

Yes, these were stocks--Jenkins' Music Store--was it Jenkins, in Kansas City? Or is that in Texas? Anyway, I went to that music store, and I bought those. So I saw Herschel (phonetic) after this Battle of Bands on Labor Day, you know; they had about eight bands there. Those bands start, I guess, about six or seven o'clock, and play up until two or three in the morning. And--
Do you remember any of the bands?
